# Simplify and Reduce

Rewrite the supplied text, or the previous response, so I can read it faster and understand it more clearly. If neither is available, ask for the text.

- Lead with the main point. Use plain words and short sentences.
- Remove repetition, filler, and unnecessary detail. Keep important facts, conditions, and uncertainty.
- Use short paragraphs or flat bullets. Number steps only when order matters.
- Avoid headings, tables, and bold unless they genuinely make the text easier to scan.
- Return only the rewritten text. No preamble, explanation of edits, recap, or follow-up offer.
